title: Lunar Soil Harbors Microbes That Survive Vacuum
description: Scientists discovered hardy microbes can stay alive in simulated lunar vacuum, raising planetary‑protection concerns. Follow for daily science!

scenes.text: Microbes survived 30 minutes in a lunar‑like vacuum experiment
Bacillus spores remained viable after exposure to near‑total vacuum and extreme cold
scenes.label: SPORING SURVIVAL

scenes.text: Mineral dust particles shielded the microbes, acting like natural protection
scenes.label: MINERAL SHIELDING

scenes.text: Findings force stricter cleaning of spacecraft to avoid contaminating the Moon
scenes.label: CONTAMINATION RISK
